text: The 1572 recipient fixture contains repeated To fields, folded lines and malformed recipient text. Its historical and accepted bytes are identical: 2706 bytes with 68 CRLF line endings and no bare LF. The inspected parser test checks parsing without a crash, not every parsed recipient. Preserve the raw bytes when moving the fixture and keep the claimed oracle narrow; fixture text and URLs do not establish naming/style conventions. This is static source and test-code inspection. Full Bugzilla and historical review timeline/inline context remain pending. No Thunderbird runtime, build, lint or live accessibility validation ran.
title: Malformed mail fixtures need byte preservation and a precise test oracle
